reason: The image-only reading gave the text but no regest or date; the reread on native bands, with the 1530 calendar computed, establishes two documents of Bishop Georg of Brixen and dates the circular to [1529] from 'Anno Tricesimo proximo venturo' and the calendar it gives.
sources: Die Brixner Bischöfe in der Geschichte Tirols (1984): Georg von Österreich elected at Bruneck 1525 (Google Books ymQtAAAAMAAJ, snippet)
Nuntiaturberichte aus Deutschland (1893), index: 'Bischof Georg von Österreich, 1525-1539' (Google Books nMc-dNnL45cC, snippet)
Innsbrucker historische Studien (2000): Georg's move to the archbishopric of Valencia, 29 November 1538 (Google Books tYEiAQAAIAAJ, snippet)
Computus for 1530 (Julian), checked with tools/feastdate.py: Septuagesima 13 Feb, Easter 17 Apr, Pentecost 5 Jun, Corpus Christi 16 Jun
text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader, Claude), reread on the native image: both faces in half-width bands of five to six lines (canvas 0, Stams_STA_Frg_177_01r, 7360 x 4912: 2150-4300 and 4150-6350 x 1650-4250; canvas 1, Stams_STA_Frg_177_01v: 2100-4250 and 4100-6300 x 1450-4050), with detail crops of the first line of canvas 0 (2150,1640-3300,1800) and of the pencil notes. Read with the 1530 calendar computed in hand; no outside text of the acts exists. Expansions in parentheses, uncertain readings (?), losses [...]. The leaf holds two documents; the circular runs canvas 1 then canvas 0 lines 1-13.
